content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to figure out how to set the weekly timer using Modbus. I've already done the variable mapping and can update the on and off times, but I'm unsure which Modbus value to send for, for example, 23:48. I found an example where one variable holds the hour and another the minutes (sent by a web editor), but I'm not sure how to send this value via Modbus. Is there a simpler way to achieve this? Here's an example of what I'm aiming for, but I'm using Modbus for communication instead. [url]

If you've checked that topic, you'll see the hour and minute are written in hexadecimal format. This format comes from legacy systems. It means using one byte for the hour as a hex value, and another byte for the minute as a hex value. You can then join both bytes as a word and send them as a holding register. The weekdays are stored as individual bits within a single byte: Bit 0 = Sunday Bit 1 = Monday Bit 2 = Tuesday Bit 3 = Wednesday Bit 4 = Thursday Bit 5 = Friday Bit 6 = Saturday
Thank you, this explanation makes it much clearer for me.
